All signs.voice_body: LOOK UP—today the sky’s giving you a bold push. Mars trine Neptune opens a channel where energy meets imagination; feel the surge of creative momentum and let it lift your projects. Yet Mars opposite Pluto warns of power struggles—your drive may feel stifled by hidden resistance or stubborn habits. Pair this with Mercury square Pluto, and communication can turn sharp, revealing buried truths that may feel unsettling. Symbolically, the trine invites you to act with purpose and vision; the opposition reminds you to temper ambition with awareness of deeper motives; the square urges honesty in dialogue, cutting through pretense. In practice: channel that energetic spark into a single creative task—write a short story, sketch, or plan a new routine. Then pause, examine any internal pushback, and speak honestly about it, perhaps with a trusted friend. This balanced move keeps your agency alive while respecting the pressure that fuels growth. Take that step and start your chosen project today.
